digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor link-audit check (graph link auditor/repair)
propositions: Durable LINK events written under the pre-structural comparability rule leave incorrect blocking edges on disk that distort ready, next-batch and the parent-first claim cascade.
A store-wide scan asks the current resolver what each net-active blocking edge should be, classifying findings as ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, or unreadable.

--repair writes the replacement link before removing the stale one so an interruption leaves a convergeable superset, declines ambiguous-pair unlinks, and force-writes a pre-doctor-repair rollback tag.
run_repair self-deadlocked by holding the non-re-entrant tracker write lock across its loop while each inner write reacquired it, timing out at 60s per item; fixed by dropping the outer lock.
On this repository's tracker 18 bad edges were found; 12 repaired and 8 inert residuals remain unrepairable because add_dependency refuses links whose source ticket is closed.
Re-parenting silently invalidates previously-correct edges, so link-audit is an ongoing periodic check rather than a one-shot cleanup.
